notes: Exported by vexlife.lens.VexLifeProdScreenLens; VexWork pins the commit.

              Local folders
              
              
              Folders on this computer Vex may read when you ask. Vex only reads them; nothing inside is changed. Your Vex Home is separate.
              
            
              
            
          
              
          
                
          
                
        
                

        
                
          
                Continuity
                
          
                
            
                Memory · Checking
                
            
                VexLife hasn't read Vex's Memory yet.
                
            
                
          
                
          
                
            Continuity mode
            
            Dream sync
            
          
                
          
                Continuity mode will choose how another device reaches Vex: as a window onto this Mac's Vex, or as a Vex of its own. Dream sync will let Vex propose what to keep from your conversations so you can accept or decline each one before anything is kept or shared. Neither exists in VexLife-Prod yet.
                
        
                


        
                
          
                Models
                
          
                Choose which local model Vex uses. Smaller models usually respond sooner and use less memory. Selecting a model does not change the running model until you press Start.
                

          
                
            
                Add a model
                
            
                Paste a public Hugging Face MLX model page. Check only inspects it; nothing is downloaded until you add it and choose Download.
                
            
            
                
              
              
            
                
            
                
            
                
          
                

          
                
            
                Current model
                
            
                
          
                

          
                
            Choose a model
            
                
              
              
                
            
                
            
                
            
                
          
                

          
                
            
                
              
                Performance & memory
                
              
                
            
                
            
            
                Vex can keep some of the recent conversation ready between replies. Keeping more ready may reduce waiting on follow-up replies, but it uses more memory. Standard is recommended.
                
            
                
              
            
                
            
                
              
                Apply model
                
              
                Choosing a model or changing its settings does not affect Vex until you start it. This is the step that changes the model Vex is using.
                
              
            
                
          
                

          
                
        
                

        
                
          
                Local voice recognition
                
          
                Choose which qualified local speech recognizer turns your microphone into editable Composer text. Audio stays on this computer.
                
          
                
            
            
          
                
          
                
          
                
            
            
          
                
          
                Choose the language your microphone should transcribe. It can differ from the language Vex replies in.
                
          
                
            
            
          
                
          
                Keep speech as spoken, including language switches, or translate supported speech to English on this computer.
                
          
                
          
                The microphone uses this selection. The transcript stays editable until you press Send.
                
          
                
        
                

        
                
          
                Debug & diagnostics
                
          
                
            
                
            
                
            
                
          
                
          
                VexLife keeps a short history of what happened (setup steps, service and model starts, sends and how they ended) so a problem can be traced to its cause. It holds no conversation text.
                
          
                
            
            
            Export debug ZIP
          
                
          
                Enhanced capture also records process and memory snapshots every 30 seconds for two hours, then stops by itself.
                
          
                The ZIP holds states, timings, process IDs, receipt summaries and short log tails. It never includes your conversations, prompts or page contents.

pathways.label: Add, cancel or remove files for the next message
pathways.summary: VexLifeAttachmentDraftFamily owns only the unsent Composer draft. Raw/derived artifact custody is separate; the exact READY snapshot is bound to the canonical REQUEST only when Send is accepted.

nodes.label: POST /api/v1/attachments/draft/stage · /api/v1/attachments/draft/control

nodes.label: READY snapshot -> exact durable REQUEST
nodes.summary: STAGED != SENT; the person's canonical REQUEST words are never rewritten into a resource manifest.

pathways.label: Send to Vex
pathways.summary: VexLifeConversationTurnFamily decides whether Send is lawful for the observed turn State. The service realizes BeginTurn; durable Conversation, provider execution and runtime truth remain separate owners.
pathways.returns: Family turn DisplayState plus the canonical Conversation projection

nodes.label: Ready + Control.Send(attempt)
nodes.summary: The Family decides lawfulness and returns Effect.BeginTurn for the exact attempt.

nodes.label: one active turn slot
nodes.summary: Request-local execution custody only; it is observed by the Family and does not own Conversation or runtime meaning.

nodes.label: DirectCompanionTurn
nodes.summary: One canonical turn. The request is appended to Conversation before inference.

nodes.label: Prompt materialization
nodes.summary: Selects recent completed turns and current Memory within the token budget and records exactly what Vex received.

nodes.label: Foundational field
nodes.summary: The versioned body the same kernel is selected from on every turn. Readable at GET /api/v1/foundational-field.

nodes.label: Current Memory
nodes.summary: Included only when the Living Journal projection is CURRENT.

nodes.label: active-turn truth → same Family
nodes.summary: Active custody yields Active(attempt); terminal release yields Ready. Provider success never manufactures Family State directly.

pathways.label: Stop current Vex turn
pathways.summary: The same ConversationTurn Family decides whether Stop is lawful for the exact Active attempt. RequestCancel is realized by request-local cancellation; the persistent model runtime is not stopped.
pathways.returns: fresh Family DisplayState after cancellation request, then Ready after terminal release

nodes.label: Active(attempt) + Control.Stop(attempt)
nodes.summary: A stale/different attempt cannot lawfully Stop the current turn.

nodes.label: request-local cancellation
nodes.summary: Interrupts only the active turn request and closes request-local resources; it owns no semantic cancellation reason and no persistent runtime handle.

nodes.label: cancellation requested → same Family
nodes.summary: If execution is still active, the active attempt plus request-local cancellation truth becomes State.Cancelling; a fast terminal release may already observe Ready.

nodes.label: TURN_CANCELLED_BY_PERSON
nodes.summary: The already-durable request receives the turn owner's terminal cancellation code in its failure receipt; no response/head is committed.

nodes.label: terminal active-slot release → same Family
nodes.summary: Once execution custody ends, observed truth becomes Ready again.

pathways.label: Add or remove a persistent local folder
pathways.summary: VexLifeLocalSourcesFamily decides grant Controls. The host picker proposes a folder, the store admits/persists the exact real directory, and later model reach remains bounded and read-only.

nodes.label: Host folder chooser
nodes.summary: The picker proposes a path; it grants nothing.

nodes.label: Persistent Local Source grants in Vex Home
sources.list · sources.find · sources.read
nodes.summary: Later model reach is relative to the exact grant, symlink-safe, bounded and read-only.

pathways.label: Resize or collapse Browser region / Companion region
pathways.summary: Browser companion handle moves or collapses its seam. A presentation-local spatial interaction: it decides nothing and no Family owns it.
